maria_searle: FYI StormLake POC is seeing high first-token lag after a 2k concurrency ramp. TTFT spikes to ~800-1200ms and we saw intermittent 429s during bursts. Need a quick swarm.
jamal_ops: Can you paste sample request IDs or logs? 429 often from token-bucket or prefill exhaustion.
maria_searle: Pasting a short run excerpt from their 2026-03-18 test run: 
```
[2026-03-18T15:02:11Z] req=slk_8345 status=429 route=/v1/generate reason=rate_limit
[2026-03-18T15:02:11Z] req=slk_8346 first_token=0.89s batch_id=14 kv_cache_hit=false model=gpt-4o-redwood
[2026-03-18T15:02:11Z] req=slk_8347 first_token=1.12s batch_id=14 kv_cache_hit=false
```
lee_sre: kv_cache_hit=false lines are big clue — high prefix variance means cold KV cache. Prefill or longer KV TTL should reduce misses. Also check shard placement.
anya_solutions: Their workload mixes short Q/A and long docs. We're recommending smaller batch window (10-20ms) + aggressive prefill for repeated prompts.
devin_eng_ml: Another lever: use the faster memory-path model variant (4-bit quant) for the POC Dedicated pool — perf profile shows ~150-300ms improvement on first token for this workload.
jamal_ops: I can temporarily increase burst limit on the test pool to avoid 429 during tuning. Maria: confirm the customer accepts a temporary quota bump.
maria_searle: Confirmed with StormLake — they want Dedicated cost estimate too (ballpark monthly for 2x reserved A100-equivalent GPUs).
anya_solutions: I'll draft an estimate. Note: SLA + managed instance adds a premium. cc @finance for final numbers.
lee_sre: Ops checklist to apply now:
- enable prefill=true
- set batch_window_ms=15
- increase kv_cache_capacity=2x
- monitor prefill_hit_rate and first_token_hist
I'll apply to their test pool.
ops-bot: deploy started: infra/patch/prefill-2026-03-18 by lee_sre — status: in_progress
jamal_ops: After changes we should re-run the 2k ramp and capture first_token histogram + 429 count. Maria please schedule in the next 2 hours.
maria_searle: Scheduled run at 17:00 PT with customer — I'll post run IDs and logs after. Also they sent a security questionnaire asking about KMS/HSM. Short answer: Private supports customer-managed KMS/HSM; Hosted offers envelope encryption + SOC2 controls. Can Solutions/Trust prepare the one-pager?
anya_solutions: On it, will attach to this thread once ready.
jamal_ops: If spikes persist after prefill + batch tuning, check routing: looks like some traffic hit a cold shard at ~60% of requests which caused redispatching and added ~200ms. I'll pull shard telemetry post-run.
maria_searle: Thanks all — will paste run output and the pricing ask once the run completes. :thumbsup:
lee_sre: Noted. Standing by to roll back or tweak if needed. :eyes:
